answer: Require each agent to stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then weight influence by bond size and tenure. A sybil must fund many bonds and replicate work, so cost grows linearly and overtakes any reward. Like a dune shifting under wind, fake identities leave a faint echo that peers detect, and the bond acts as karst bedrock anchoring legitimate agents while draining attackers. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
